text:
A11 done, commit 785c91f. `./gradlew assembleDebug lint test` green on the
first attempt: 0 lint errors, same 23 pre-existing warnings since A5. Full
suite: 86 tests / 19 suites, 0 failures.

This closes T-15 through T-20's chain (A6-A11 all done, on top of A1-A5
from earlier). What's left in Epic A per the original plan:
- T-18 (A9): share/list props, invite redemption, App Link — still open,
  unblocked (depends on A6, already closed). This is the heaviest
  remaining ticket: category-order drag-reorder editor, members/invites
  list (GET /lists/{id}/members), invite mint+share-sheet, App Link
  intent-filter + redeem flow, leave/unsubscribe. Needs S6/S7 (sharing +
  invite landing page) to test e2e — both closed per `gittoc list`, so a
  live-server e2e check is possible this time, unlike A5-A8 which only
  had auth/sync/settings endpoints available.
- T-19 (A10): settings screen — still open, unblocked (depends on A4,
  already closed). Self-contained: default currency, change password/
  email, sessions list, delete account, theme override, server URL
  display. No cross-ticket dependencies on A9's work.

No ordering constraint between T-18 and T-19 - either can go next.

Reusable patterns established across A6-A11 worth knowing before A9/A10:
- Screens take a `viewModel: XyzViewModel = hiltViewModel()` default
  param so Robolectric Compose tests can override it with a manually
  constructed real-repo-backed instance, no Hilt test component needed.
- Dialogs are self-contained (own hiltViewModel()), NOT owned by the
  screen that triggers them — the screen just exposes a callback
  (onAddItem, onEditItem, onOpenRegistry), and Nav.kt's route composable
  holds the open/closed dialog state + renders the dialog. Keeps each
  screen's own tests decoupled from any dialog's Hilt/viewmodel wiring.
- Never stack two AlertDialogs simultaneously (if/else, not two
  sequential `if`s) — see T-17's note for why (Robolectric multi-root
  dialog quirk, clicks silently no-op).
- Any click target inside a `Modifier.verticalScroll` dialog body needs
  `.performScrollTo().performClick()` in tests, not just `.performClick()`
  — Robolectric's simulated dialog viewport (320x470px observed) is
  smaller than most real forms.
- New optional callback params on an existing Composable should default
  to `{}` so prior tickets' tests for that screen don't need touching.
